capabilities.title: Grid search enumerates the full cartesian product of a discrete configuration space
capabilities.rationale: Both SDKs pass this fixture through their public optimize entry point with algorithm "grid": Python SDK tests/unit/parity/test_conformance_grid.py (Traigent develop bf57c2b5) and the JS SDK parity conformance test (develop cb4fa5de). Both assert raw invocation count, no duplicates, set equality, and max-trials truncation. Parameter ordering is not part of the contract.
